[/p][p]Additional information:[/p][p] [/p][p]This is an Anomaly Event! The following rule changes will apply:[/p][p]
SKIRMISH PHASE[/p][p]1.      Ships of any rarity can be used at all difficulty levels.[/p][p]2.      Additional 1500 and 1800 Intel tiers are introduced, increasing the top repeating threshold to 1800 Intel.[/p][p]3.      Elite difficulty opponents are upgraded to Epic difficulty level, Elite difficulty rewards are upgraded to Epic difficulty rewards.[/p][p]4.      Epic difficulty opponent stats are 20% higher, Epic difficulty rewards are doubled.[/p][p]
GALAXY PHASE[/p][p]1.      Each Supply Mission requires 2 of each item instead of 1.[/p][p]2.      Turning in the Rare Item gives out 5x Victory Points.[/p][p]3.      Double rare reward chance increment after a failed crafting attempt:[/p][p]- There are two Phases to this Event! Each Phase is individually timed.[/p][p]- In this Hybrid Event, you will complete Ship Battles in one Phase, and Supply Missions in another Phase.[/p][p]- Unique Ship Battles and Supply Missions are available during the event. Open the Event to access them.[/p][p]- Using Ayelborne, any version of Trelane, Q, Miss Q, or Cosmic crew will provide a bonus to Ship Battles and Supply Missions.[/p][p]- Using the Species 8472 Bioship, the U.S.S. Enterprise NCC-1701-D, or the - - -- --[/p][p]Constitution Class Ship will provide a hull bonus in Skirmish Battles.[/p][p]- Community Rewards are also available during Phase 2![/p][p]- Every Ship Battle or Supply Mission you complete earns you Event Victory Points.Collect Event Victory Points to unlock Threshold Rewards![/p][p]- In this event, Squadrons may also compete to advance up the Squadron leaderboards. Join a Squadron to get more rewards![/p][p] [/p][p]Live long and prosper,[/p][p]
The Star Trek Timelines Team[/p][p]

[/p]

notes.title: Client Release Notes 11.1.0
notes.notes:
Greetings, Captains,

Our latest client, v11.1.0 is now live on Facebook..

The releases will happen on different days for the various platforms the game is available on. This will allow us to monitor that everything is working as it should. Don’t hesitate to let us know of any issue you might encounter.

- Windows & Steam today
- Google Play & Google Play for PC on Thursday March 20th
- iOS on Monday March 24th
- Remaining platforms to follow.

The forced update is tentatively scheduled for Monday, March 31st, after which v11.1.0 will be mandatory to continue playing.

With this update we’re introducing the following changes:

Functionality to support the scheduling of Specialist Events, what we are intending replacing Galaxy Events in the future.

[list]
[*] [b]Removal of Crafting[/b] - comparing directly to Galaxy Events, Specialist Events will no longer use the crafting mechanic. Players will spend chronitons directly to engage in the new Specialist Missions.
[*] [b]Greater Crew Depth Strategy[/b] - involving locking crew into a Specialist Mission, where they will generate VP similar to how crew slotting in Galaxy Events work with the exception they will go on Cooldown to facilitate the use of more crew within the event.
[*] [b]Expected rollout[/b] - We are aiming to run a similar mid-week Beta Test event at the conclusion of this client’s full rollout. We will communicate around expectations when our transition from Galaxy Events to Specialist Events happens with the regular competitive weekend event cadence.
[/list]
[b]Additional fixes and improvements:
[/b]QP level is now present in the crew that has unlocked at least 1 Quipment slot
Quick Build allowed for Quipment
Crew allocated to Skirmish removed from ship crew slot when used for fusing. 

Thank you for playing,

The STAR TREK TIMELINES Team

notes.title: Voyages Rewards Update
notes.notes:
Greetings, Captains,
With the [b]08.08.2023 deploy[/b], we will be introducing an [b]update to Voyages[/b]. We will be converting the 5-star Voyage Exclusive Reward into a Behold choice of crew as well as adding a chance for Premium Portal 4-star rewards to be Beholds instead. Voyage Exclusive 4-star Rewards will become a Behold with the original specific crew as a fixed option. Lastly, specific ship schematic rewards will become a Behold where the choice will be between a fixed specific ship schematic, along with two premium portal available ship schematics of the same rarity.

[*] Where Earth Meets Sky

notes.title: New Year’s Gift, and DS9 30th Anniversary Giveaway!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28588170/e7bedd0e50d27e9846f94ce2ff58a1338e00cc13.png[/img]

Greetings, Captains,


As you may know we had issues with our in-game mail system that prevented us from sending weekly emails, including the New Year’s gift we had prepared.
This is now resolved hourray! 

However, for our New Year’s gift we’ve decided to make it a special free pack instead. Starting tomorrow, [b]January 10, around 17:00 UTC (noon ET)[/b] you will find it in the Time Portal where it will be available for a week, until Tuesday January 17. 

The whole Star Trek Timelines and Wicked Realm Games team wishes you a new year full of joy and prosperity!

On top of our anniversary we’re also celebrating 30 years of DS9 this year. To commemorate both occasions, and Louise Fletcher’s impact on the series, we’re introducing a new crew to the game, Kai Winn.

Kai Winn will be made available via a free pack in the Time Portal, and you’ll be able to participate in a month-long Objective Event to gain additional copies.

Both the pack and the Objective Event will go live on [b]Tuesday, January 10 at 5:00 UTC (12:00am ET)[/b]. 

The pack will be available until Tuesday, February 7, around 17:00 UTC (noon ET), the accompanying Objective Event will run until Tuesday February 7 at 5:00 UTC (12:00am ET).

Thank you for being part of our community, and for your continued support.

Live long and prosper,


The STAR TREK TIMELINES Team

notes.title: Ho-Ho-Honor Sale Soon and updates!
notes.notes:
Greetings, Captains!

The festive season is upon us, this feels like a good time for an Honor Sale!

It will start tomorrow, [b]Tuesday, December 13 around noon ET (17:00 UTC)[/b] with the following:


[i][b]Webstore/In-game[/b][/i]
- [b]Special Packs[/b]: these packs are purchasable with Honor, you’ll have the choice between 3 different packs to get 1x 1/5 crew among crew currently available in the regular packs from the Time Portal! Packs with a purchase limit will refresh daily at noon ET (17:00 UTC).

Pack 1: 
For a price of 10,000 Honor this pack [b]will have no purchase limit[/b], and will grant you 1x 1/5 random crew ([b]no behold[/b]).

Pack 2:
For a price of 10,000 Honor this pack will have a [b]purchase limit of 1 a day[/b], and will grant you [b]1x 1/5 Behold[/b] (a choice between 3 crew).

Pack 3:
For a price of 40,000 Honor pack this pack will have [b]a purchase limit of 10 a day[/b], and will grant you [b]1x 1/5 Behold[/b] + [b]1x 5*citation[/b].


[i][b]Webstore 2022-12-13 / In-game 2022-12-14[/b][/i]
- [b]Special Honor Offers[/b]: these offers will allow you to purchase Honor and a 5* citation. They will each have their own purchase limit. [b]These offers will be available in the webstore first, and will be more advantageous as they will offer 5% more Honor![/b]

The sale will end on Tuesday, December 20, around noon ET (17:00 UTC)

[b][u]State of the game - December 2022[/b][/u]
WRG_Ben spent a bit of time chatting with players on Discord and wanted to give a game update to everyone.

[b]9.2.0[/b]
This new client is currently scheduled to be released in early January. We know a lot of you are eagerly waiting for the restriction regarding who can start a Fleet Boss Battle. We wanted to get this out sooner but this update also requires an engine upgrade which is a big task involving a lot of testing. Thank you for your patience. 

What else can you look forward to with this new client?
- Improved Voyage ship selection screen.
- Away Missions: get more information from that screen (proficiencies, traits bonus, critical success rate) to help you choose the best crew for the task.
- Fleet Boss Battles improvements and bug fixes. On the improvements’s side: limiting who can start a battle, but also ensuring that the trait combination on a node will be present on at  least 2 crew already in the Time Portal. This will be most visible/helpful for the last 2 difficulty modes as they allow for all types of crew and will reduce the instances where only one crew can solve a node.
- Captain’s Bridge expansion with more rewards and buffs to look forward to.


[b]10.0.0[/b]

Yes, we’re also working on what will come in the next update after 9.2.0, and, among other things, it will be a new feature involving Immortalized Crew. It is too early to share more details at this juncture but in a few months we’ll have a specific video stream about it!

We hope you enjoyed this preview of what’s to come. We take this opportunity to thank you for being on this adventurous ride with us, and we wish you a joyous festive season!

Thank you for being part of our community,

The STAR TREK TIMELINES Team

notes.title: Announcing our ‘Second Contact’ Mega Event!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28588170/7701383f1909197dc20e5d96a1efeeb4af7bcd4c.png[/img]

Greetings, Captains,

Our next mega arc will commence on Thursday, October 6, we hope you are ready for it!

We all know about first contact stories, but what about second contacts, especially with all timelines mingled..

[i]The Cerritos is out on cleanup duty, hoping to make up for some of the Federation’s less than stellar first contacts! Making matters worse is the fact that the Federation has insisted their efforts be overseen by an experienced ambassador - specifically Doopler! Can you help the Cerritos crew make some positive connections while keeping Doopler under control?[/i]

The Cerritos and yourself will encounter, and maybe receive help from, various new characters such as: Master Surchid Falow (DS9), Talosian Keeper (DSC), Gathorel Labin (VOY), Kiley Pike (SNW), Breakthrough Booker (DSC), Jen Sh’reyan (LD), Captain Vasso L’Gaelia (SNW),and Borg Queen Jurati (PIC).

Doppler (LD) will be the recurrent threshold rewards, available in all 4 events, crew with the ‘diplomat’ trait will provide an event bonus for all events.

The schedule is as follows:

- [b]2022-10-06[/b]: “Playtime” - [b]Galaxy[/b] Event
- [b]2022-10-13[/b]: “Living a Legend” - [b]Skirmish [/b]Event, new ship: Sikarian Vessel
- [b]2022-10- 20[/b]: “Dramatic Relations” - [b]Faction/Galaxy[/b] Event
- [b]2022-10-27[/b]: “Enemies to Allies” - [b]Faction Event[/b]

We’re looking forward to your participation and hope you will enjoy this new and unique narrative arc.

Thank you for playing,

The STAR TREK TIMELINES Team

notes.title: 9.1.0 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
What’s new in Version 9.1.0:
With this new update we’re introducing bugs fixes and improvements to Fleet Boss Battles.
- Unlocking a combo will now provide a fleet wide buff that will help all fleet members against the boss!
- Fleet members will be able to individually re-roll a combo buff for a new one
- Battle Results will now be shown to all participants
- Crew selection will now show frozen crew
- Fixed an issue with traits being incorrectly grayed out

notes.title: Fleet Boss Battles Downtime
notes.notes:
Greetings, Captains,

We’re getting ready to release our next client update, v9.1.0, and prior to this we need to take Fleet Boss Battles offline for about a week.

Starting on [b]Sunday, 2022-08-28[/b], at 10am ET (14:00 UTC) it will no longer be possible to start any [b]NEW boss battles[/b].

Battles that are in progress at that time will remain available for the duration of their timer, allowing you to complete them.

Fleet Boss Battles will return after the release of v9.1.0 and the forced update that is currently scheduled for [b]Tuesday, September 6[/b].

We apologize for the inconvenience this might cause.

It will be worth the wait as we have many fixes and improvements in store for the feature, such as:
- a fix for traits being grayed out incorrectly
- a change to threshold rewards to ensure everyone participating will be eligible for rewards, destruction rewards included
- an improved experience when selecting crew for a node, including a search function, crew currently in the vault (+ ability to unfreeze directly), and more relevant traits displayed
- the introduction of a fleet wide buff when unlocking a combo chain + an individual reroll ability

More details soon in our client release notes but also in our upcoming stream that will take place on Wednesday, 2022-08-31, at 4pm ET (20:00 UTC)! In the stream WRG Ben will also talk about what we are planning for Star Trek Day!

https://www.youtube.com/c/WickedRealmGames


Thank you for playing,

The STAR TREK TIMELINES Team

notes.title: Client Release Notes 9.0.0
notes.notes:
Greetings, Captains,

Our latest client, v9.0.0 is now live on Facebook. It will be rolled out to Steam, Windows and Google Play next Tuesday, on iOS on Wednesday, followed by a release on our other android platforms (Amazon, Huawei, and Samsung).

A force update is currently scheduled for 07/11 after which v9.0.0 will be mandatory to continue playing. 

With this update we’re introducing [b]Fleet Boss Battles[/b], a brand new feature that will present new challenges for you and your fleet!

In Fleet Boss Battles you will encounter powerful Star Trek enemies, the first one that you ‘ll be tasked to defeat is the Doomsday Machine.

Fleet Boss Battles will have 6 levels of difficulty. Each difficulty level allows for different crew and ship rarity to be used. Once a Battle is started you’ll have 24 hours to deal as much damage as you can.

Master a difficulty level by defeating the Boss, and to unlock the next difficulty level.
Increased difficulty means higher Hull value for the Boss, but also better rewards.

Deal massive damage to the Boss’ Hull by discovering [b]Combo Chains[/b].
To discover a Combo Chain you will be required to use crew with specific traits, using the correct crew with the correct traits will unlock the relevant node. 

A trait will be shown for each node, alongside a list of other potential traits. This will change for each Combo Chain. 
Discovering all nodes for a Combo Chain will trigger a massive attack on the Boss, and unlock the next Combo Chain.

The number of Combo Chains, their composition (nodes amount), and Hull damage will vary depending on the difficulty level chosen.

To give everyone a chance to unmask a Combo Chain node, once you discover one, you will no longer be able to contribute to the discovery of additional nodes for that specific combo. You will however be able to participate in the next Combo Chain once it’s unlocked.

Alongside regular rewards, participating in Fleet Boss Battles will also grant you specific components, allowing you to build and upgrade your Bridge.

The Captain Bridge will be accessible via the Manifest, upgrading the Bridge will unlock permanent buffs for your ships!
That’s not all, you will also be able to gain exclusive rewards, such as ships and crew.
The appearance of the Bridge will change with each upgrade level, this includes being populated with crew.

We know this is a lot to take in all at once, now might be a good time to give a gameplay video a rewatch!  

[b]The Fleet Boss Battles and the Bridge icons will be visible once you upgrade to 9.0.0 but will remain locked until after the force update.[/b]

We’re excited to bring you this new challenge and cannot wait to see how you will tackle it.

Please keep in mind that the initial launch of Fleet Boss Battles is considered a beta. Adjustments and improvements will be made post release. 

Thank you for playing,

The STAR TREK TIMELINES Team

notes.title: Announcing our Players's Choice Mega-Event: Living Vessel
notes.notes:
Greetings Captains,

As part of our June Players’ Choice tradition, back in March you were asked to vote for the theme of this month's mega arc. The three options were:

- Facets of the Past (DS9 + Trill) 
- Tin Man / Bio-Ships (TNG/VOY + Astrophysicist or Exobiologist)
- Archer Mega (ENT + Inspiring)

The winner was Tin Man/Bio-Ships, let’s explore what this mega-event will be about.
 
[i]Starfleet is evaluating the use of organic ships within their ranks. However, the “Tin Man” returns, not quite the docile creature  he was once known to be. This frightening encounter is only a prelude to a bigger nightmare, as a crew dispatched to study the wreckage of a Species 8472 bioship disappears and the remnants of their doomed expedition could herald disaster for the entire galaxy.[/i]

For the duration of this mega-event crew with the ‘astrophysicist’ trait will provide an event bonus for all four events, the schedule will be as follows:

2022-06-02 - Skirmish event - Blight - this event will introduce a new ship: Gomtuu!
2022-06-09 - Galaxy Event - Pruned
2022-06-16 - Faction/Galaxy Event - Apoptosis
2022-06-23 - Faction Event - Pluripotency

Our recurrent mega arc crew will be ‘Infected Tryla Scott’ (Star Trek: The Next Generation - “Conspiracy”).

Participate in all four events to obtain a copy from threshold rewards, and to encounter other new characters such as: Captain Robert DeSoto, Lt. JG Picard, Lt. Commander Spock (Star Trek: Strange New Worlds), Lt. Commander MacDougal, Ruon Tarka, Surata IV La Forge, Hollow Data, and Disorderly Icheb.
We hope you’ll enjoy this new original story arc, thank you for playing!


LLAP,

The STAR TREK TIMELINES Team

notes.title: Celebrating Women’s History Month, and more!
notes.notes:
Greetings, Captains!

March is Women’s History Month and we’re celebrating with a free behold pack available in the Time Portal until Wednesday, March 30 around noon ET (16:00 UTC).

March also means Spring has arrived, and it is as good a reason as any to have a catch up session!

To that effect WRG_Ben made an appearance on Timelines Talks, a player-run stream, and here’s the summary of what has been discussed.

Let’s start with things to look forward to in April:

[b]April 3[/b]: WRG_Ben, Joe and Fury will make a special appearance for the charity stream that will take place on that day. Feel free to join in on Twitch to say hi.

[b]April 5[/b]: First Contact Day! 
We’ll have free crew slots, a new collection for the ‘ displaced’ trait, and a free pack to celebrate our presence at ..

[b]April 8 - April 10[/b]: Star Trek: Mission Chicago!
That’s right, STAR TREK TIMELINES will have a presence at the convention.
If you are attending, do not miss WRG_Ben’s panel on Saturday (04/09). He will talk about the game’s history and share some stories. To top it all he will also be in the gaming area to demo the game and provide a first look at the brand new feature we are working on.

Now for some Qs and As:

- Will the Honor Hall new crew pace continue and will there be a Honor Hall collection?
We plan on continuing to add new Honor Hall crew, but do not have a specific cadence in mind. As for a specific collection, it is still undecided at this time.

- Crew Retrieval was released one year ago, did the feature perform as expected? 
Yes! Thanks to the hard work of our design and engineering teams we were able to release this feature and solve a pain point. We’re satisfied with the results, and with the opportunities this gives to players.

- Are there any plans for more Episodes or Distress Calls?
There is at least one Distress Call we’d like to release, but it is a question of priority and resources. It is not off the table yet!

- Lower Decks in STT?
We’re still working on it, it is coming along.

- Are Objective Events achieving their goals?
We have multiple goals with Objective Events, and that is why they will vary in style.
The main goal is to provide something for players to engage with on Tuesdays and Wednesdays. The Endurance Objective Events also provide us with an easier way to have month-long giveaways. There will be more iterations done for existing OEs and you can also expect to see some that will be more specifically aimed at new players, as a way to surface various aspects of STT gameplay.

- Can a new type of event be expected?
This is still very much on our list, and design work has been done to explore some ideas.

- Will existing achievements be updated?
This is something we’d like to do, but it first requires making sure that doing so would not break anything.

- How about collections for 4* and 5*, or crew with pets?
It has not been ruled out but due to the amount of crew involved we’d first need to rethink what it would look like, tiers and rewards wise.

A collection for crew with pets is also something we’d like to do but any collection that does not involve a trait is less easy to set up and has to be scheduled more carefully.

- Community Rewards in all event types?
This is still something we’d like to do but at this time there are other items that take priority.

- Will there be more areas of the game, such as the arena, that will integrate the search function for crew?
This is something we’d like to do, but it is a lower priority at this time.

- The fuse/immortalization objective in Objective Events is a burden on a lot of players, will it be revised? 
Player’s feedback was very clear on this so we are looking at some iteration, this will take some time however.

- Any update on the Voyage bug?
We’ve been unlucky so far but we hope the latest analytics added with 8.3.0 will provide us with useful information.

- Are we considering new features for this year?
Yes, we are exploring a lot of ideas and one of them is coming along nicely and will involve fleet and crew depth! We’ll soon be able to share more details about it, starting with Star Trek: Mission Chicago! A very tentative schedule for this feature is late Q2. There are also plans for additions in Q3 and Q4, but keep in mind that it is subject to change.


We’re excited about what’s in store for STAR TREK TIMELINES this year, and we cannot wait to talk more about it.


Thank you for playing,

The STAR TREK TIMELINES Team

notes.title: Client Release Notes 8.2.2
notes.notes:
Greetings, Captains,

Our latest client, v8.2.2 is now live on Facebook and Steam. It will be rolled out to Windows, Google Play, and iOS next week, followed by a release on our other android platforms (Amazon, Huawei, and Samsung).

This new update will introduce various changes, some [b]of these changes will only go live once all players are on v8.2.2.[/b] A forced update is currently scheduled for 02/28 after which v8.2.2 will be mandatory to continue playing.

What’s new in v8.2.2?

[b]New loading screen[/b]
It was time for a change, wasn’t it? 
This new loading screen highlights Captain Picard's beginnings with [i]Star Trek: The Next Generation[/i]. Just in time, as we’re about to follow him on his next adventure with [i]Star Trek: Picard[/i] Season 2!

[b]Event Hub[/b]
We’ve made some improvements to the Event Hub:
- an informational text is now available and depicts what types of events can be found in the Event Hub
- Objective Events will now unlock at level 4 and will show an icon to identify their type
- Objective Events will now show progress more clearly, instead of showing percentages

Our goal with Objective Events is to have different sets of them, to cater to a wide range of players. 
Training Events will be aimed towards newer players, to help them get familiarized with various aspects of game play. 
Power Up Events will be geared towards more experienced players, engaged in performing well in competitive events.
Endurance Events, which are our month long events for special occasions.

[b]Quantum Pass[/b] (not live yet)
Purchasing the Quantum Pass will allow you to collect 50 Quantum per day, for 10 consecutive days, providing a boost for your Crew Retrieval efforts.
The Quantum Pass will make its debut on Tuesday, February 28, once all players are on 8.2.2.


We hope you’ll enjoy this new update, and are looking forward to your feedback.


Thank you for playing,

The STAR TREK TIMELINES Team

notes.title: Announcing our February Mega Arc: Torn Apart, Brought Together
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28588170/8fcde92f2a925bf8934b34b7bb69af65c562fb10.png[/img]

Our first mega-event of 2022 is brought to you by none other than Q..

[i]As a way to create chaos across the galaxy (or perhaps just to mitigate his own boredom), Q has swapped crews across quadrants and across faction lines, breaking up strong teams, friends, and families alike. While Starfleet is strong in individual members, it’s stronger still as a unified whole.[/i]

You will be instrumental in bringing Starfleet back together, are you up to the task?

In this endeavor you’ll receive assistance from caregivers, as crew with the ‘caregiver’ trait will provide an event bonus for all four events. 

Along the way you’ll encounter various new characters such as: Dahj on the run, Angel Gabrielle Burnham, Prisoner Spock, Mournful Elnor, Security Laris, Zhaban, Sanctuary Booker, and Reunion Raffi.

The schedule of events will be as follow:

[b]02/03[/b] - “Starship Scramble” - Faction Event
[b]02/10[/b] - “Closing the Distance” - Galaxy Event
[b]02/17[/b] - “Chaos and Confusion” - Skirmish Event
[b]02/24[/b] - “Powderkeg” - Faction/Galaxy Event

Graduation Amanda Grayson will be the recurrent threshold reward throughout this mega arc, allowing you to gain four copies in total. She is also part of three collections! (‘Great Compassion’, ‘Live Long and Prosper’, and ‘Healthy Discourse'). 

We hope you will enjoy this mega-event, live long and prosper!


The STAR TREK TIMELINES Team

Greetings, Captains, 

We’re getting close to the end of the year but there are still things to enjoy in 2021, our December Mega-Event being one of them!

“Spread Throughout the Stars” will run from Thursday to Monday, for four weeks starting on Thursday December 2. The inspiration behind the title refers to how Captain Kirk viewed the Federation as “a dream that became reality and spread throughout the stars”.

[i]As a true believer in the Federation’s ideals, Lieutenant Sahil decides to pay tribute to the greatest cultural figures from across the galaxy. His intentions are good, but they spark many a disagreement, ultimately leading to the theft of a priceless artifact and an increase in tensions! Help make Lieutenant Sahil’s celebration of the galaxy’s best and brightest a success - with minimal collateral damage![/i]

The schedule of events will be as follow:

[b]12/02[/b] - “Scars of History” - Faction Event
[b]12/09[/b] - “Fragments of the Past” - Galaxy Event
[b]12/16[/b] - “Problems of the Present” - Faction/Galaxy Event
[b]12/23[/b] - “Flying for the Future” - Skirmish Event

The recurrent bonus trait for this event will be “[b]cultural figure[/b]”, and the recurrent threshold reward will be no other than [b]Lieutenant Sahil[/b]!

During this mega arc you will encounter various new crew such as Prophet Kira, Quarren of the Kyrian, Ancient Humanoid, Patar, K’mpec, Sukal, Arev, and Skorr Tchar.

notes.title: Client Release Notes 8.2.0
notes.notes:
Greetings, Captains,

Our latest client, v8.2.0 is now live on Facebook and Steam. It will be rolled out to Windows and Google Play in the coming days. The iOS release is scheduled for next week, followed by a release on our other android platforms (Amazon, Huawei, and Samsung).

A force update is currently scheduled for Monday, November 8 after which v.8.2.0 will be required to be able to play. To celebrate this release, [b]a free Chronitons pack [/b]will be made available for players who are on the new version, it will be claimable in the Time Portal.

For this new game update we’ve focused on some quality of life improvements, bug fixes, and a new feature: Objective Events. 

[b]Objective Events (not live yet)[/b]
Objective Events will replace temporary achievements but more importantly they will become a regular activity you’ll be able to enjoy in between our regular weekly events.

For more details about Objective Events please refer to our “Introduction to Objective Events” communique. If you no longer have it in your in-game mailbox, you’ll be able to find it on our forums, and in our Support Guide Center.
https://forum.disruptorbeam.com/stt/discussion/18660/introduction-to-objective-events/

We will have a visual first look at Objective Events, and some parts of our 8.2.0 client update, available for you soon, stay tuned!

[b]Improvements and bug fixes[/b]

[b][i]Interface changes[/b][/i]
- the Galaxy map now offers a more intuitive option to return to the main interface
- Dailies folder replaces the Daily Missions tab: inside you’ll be able to access Daily Missions, Daily Login Rewards, the Campaign, and Cadet Challenges
- Captain Achievements have been relocated to the Captain’s profile
- Daily Login Rewards: we’ve made it clearer that they follow the calendar month, and that the last reward shown is a preview of the first day of the next month
- Voyage: you can now start a Voyage directly from the main interface
- Limited Offers have been relocated above the Purchases folder - [b]Known issue[/b]: for the “Double Your Crew” offer, if you are eligible for one, a restart might be needed if you play on a platform that is not yet on 8.2.0 when the offer triggers.  

[u]Not live yet:[/u] 
- no interface mode:  this toggleable option will allow you to make some amazing screen captures. Space is beautiful!
- the Get Menu will show in which faction store the selected item is currently available
- Dabo animation on the Purchases folder: the folder will show an animation of the Dabo Wheel to indicate that Dabo has reset. The animation will disappear once the wheel is spun once. This will first be tested on a small portion of players.

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
- fixed an issue where the Get Menu would incorrectly show missions for items that were already claimed as Rare Rewards
- inventory selection will no longer reset after dematerializing a polestar
- ending a Cadet Challenge will bring you back to the Cadet Challenge panel instead of the main interface

[b]Improvements[/b]
- Fleets: a new filter is available and shows fleet dailies completion status for all fleet members
- The Replicator panel now shows how many replicator uses you have remaining for that day
- Collection information is now available in the crew details popup, and in the crew details
This will allow you to quickly see if a crew is part of a collection and will also display your current progress in said collection.
- New behold packs: thanks to new technology, for some packs, we’ll be able to offer more variety in the choices offered via a behold, such as mixed rarity crew for instance. This will only apply to specific new packs.


Thank you for your continued support, and for your patience as we were putting the final touches on this new version of the game. We’re excited to show you our work, and we hope you are too.


The STAR TREK TIMELINES Team

Greetings, Captains!

We’re putting the final touches to our next update, v8.2.0, that is set to be released at the end of this month. We needed additional time for iterations, corrections, and implementation - but we are now getting close! 

On top of various improvements and bug fixes, this new version contains the groundwork for Objective Events!

“[i]Originally we announced that we were aiming for our first objective event to take place at the end of October. Part of the fun and challenge in game development is to discover new potential when working on a new feature. It was the case with Objective Events!

We then made the decision that it was worth it to take a little extra time to explore and implement these new opportunities, which meant delaying the release of v8.2.0. Being transparent with our release timings comes with risks, as we know that in game development delays happen.

Our new target for the first objective event is either the 2nd or 3rd week of November, and we're excited for you to take part in it[/i].”-WRG Ben 

Objective Events are a new activity that you’ll be able to participate in outside of our regular weekly events. They will have a simple format, and will also be how we do temporary achievements in the future.

Greetings, Captains!

Tomorrow will mark the 55th anniversary of Star Trek's debut on television, on September 8, 1966!

55 years, what a momentous legacy, one that does not show any signs of stopping, and we couldn’t be more proud to be part of the Star Trek family.

Starting on [b]Wednesday, September 8, at 1am ET (5am UTC)[/b] we’ll be celebrating with:

This free pack will be claimable in the Time Portal until [b]Wednesday, September 22, at 12pm ET (16:00 UTC)[/b].

- three temporary achievements to obtain three additional copies of “Spock and I-Chaya”

These temporary achievements will require to: 
- do 200 crew level up 
- start 80 space battles
- start 75 shuttle missions

Complete the achievements and claim their rewards [b]before Wednesday, September 22 at 1am ET (5:00 UTC)[/b]!


Thank you for celebrating all that is Star Trek with us, don’t hesitate to share what Star Trek means to you on our social channels and our forums.

Here’s what our very own Fury had to say about Star Trek:

[i]“It's funny, even before I got into Star Trek, I kind of always knew I'd get there eventually.
ST:XI in 2009 was what finally did it, and I watched TOS sequentially until I found ST:IV The Voyage Home and its space whale saviors of the planet, George & Gracie.

I was 13 or so in 2009, so the messages from TOS - and then TNG - really rooted themselves in my thoughts. Star Trek showed off a multifaceted complexity in its characters in a way I hadn't really seen in much of the media I'd been into beforehand - Bones was a person with flaws and a real temper as well as an excellent physician, moral reasoner, and confidant. 
Spock was this perfect genius but still in his heart a sassy disaster like the rest of us. Data, MY BOY, really resonated with me, and taught me to think about what it meant to be a person in a way I never had before. He kicked off my lifelong love of androids and fictional intelligent machines.

When I look back, I think I can trace a good deal of my personal growth decisions to things I learned on the Enterprise. You don't have to be an archetype, you don't have to be one thing. You can be anything under the stars!”[/i]


Live long and keep on trekking!

The STAR TREK TIMELINES Team

notes.title: Star Trek Day, our next update, and more!
notes.notes:
Greetings, Captains, 

How about some game news? We have interesting things to share with you all!

For the viewers of Timelines Talks, a player run Twitch stream, this was the subject of yesterday's stream in which WRG_Ben participated. 

[b]Engage! Things to look forward to this September:[/b]

Monday is Labor Day in the USA, a high value citation based offer will be available on that day.

[b]Star Trek Day Celebrations:[/b] on September 8 we will mark the occasion with a free crew giveaway, and three temporary achievements as a way to get three additional copies! The full details will be communicated next week. 

Psst: There is a puzzle tease on our forums for those of you who want to try and guess who that new character will be. https://forum.disruptorbeam.com/stt/discussion/18525/new-crew-teaser

There will be a Birthday Behold purchasable pack available on [b]Walter Koenig’s birthday, on September 10[/b]. The behold will allow you to choose between Platonian Chekov, Dancing Checkov, and First Officer Chekov.

On [b]September 28[/b] a new collection will go live, this time for immortalized crew with the [b]“primal”[/b] trait.

Additionally we’re also planning on having an [b]honor sale[/b], and to add [b]a new character to the Honor Hall[/b], stay tuned for more information on this at a later date.


[b]Upcoming client update v8.2.0[/b]

Our next client update will contain various bug fixes and quality of life changes. 
The release is tentatively scheduled for the end of September followed by a force update. Some of the changes listed in this communique will only be available once all players are on v.8.2.0.

[b]- Interface changes:[/b]
_ You will be able to [b]hide[/b] the interface, yes this is happening, and we’re looking forward to your amazing screen captures
_ the Galaxy map will offer a more intuitive option to return to the main interface
_ similarly to the Manifest folder, Daily Missions will also become a folder. Inside you’ll be able to access: Daily Missions, Daily Login Rewards, the Campaign, and Cadet Challenges
_ Captain Achievements will change location and will be accessible via the Captain’s profile
_ the Daily Login Rewards panel will make it clearer that it follows the calendar month.

We’ll also be testing the following changes on some players:
_ Purchases folder: the folder will show an animation of the Dabo Wheel to indicate that Dabo has reset. The animation will disappear once the wheel is spun once.
_ Voyage: making this feature accessible directly from the main interface 

[b]- Bug fixes:[/b] 
_ fixed an issue where the Get Menu would incorrectly show missions for items that were already claimed as Rare Rewards
_ inventory selection will no longer reset after dematerializing a polestar
_ ending a Cadet Challenge will bring you back to the Cadet Challenge panel instead of the main interface

[b]- Improvements and features:[/b]
_ Fleets: a new filter will be provided to show fleet dailies completion status for all fleet members
_ The Get Menu will show when an item is also available in a faction store
_ The Replicator panel will show how many replicator uses you have remaining for that day
_ Collection information will be displayed in the crew details popup and in the crew details
You will be able to see which collections the current crew is in, your current owned and immortalized progress to the next milestone
_ Beholds will be more diverse, in the future you may see mixed rarity crew beholds. And maybe some schematics
_ Objective events are coming! Sharing some similarities with temporary achievements, these  mid-week solo objective based events will be part of the Event Hub, and will allow you to complete tasks for various rewards. We’re hoping to release the first one at the end of October. We will share more information on this in due time.


[b]- Crew Retrieval and Celestial Market[/b]
These systems are pretty rare for games of the CCRPG type (card collector role playing game), and it was a daunting endeavor. But we’re proud of how it turned out and by how it was received!

Here are some fun Celestial Market stats that we wanted to share with you:

- Over 150,000 transactions have been executed.
- Over 120,000 Polestars and over 20,000 Constellations have changed hands.
- The most sold items are the human, federation, and starfleet polestars.
- Since the week of July 26 - Aug 1st to present, the average polestar unit price has increased by 26.3%. 
- A Friar Data Tuck constellation was purchased for 9,353,693 ISM. This is puzzling WRG_Ben, and it threw off all of his charts! He will recover.
- As of Monday, the average constellation unit price is 2,739 ISM and the average polestar unit price is 4,970 ISM.


We are looking forward to an exciting September, we hope you are too!

Thank you for playing,


The STAR TREK TIMELINES Team

notes.title: The Celestial Market is Live!
notes.notes:
Greetings, Captains!

We’re happy to announce that our new feature, the [b]Celestial Market[/b], is now live!

The Celestial Market is now accessible to all players, level 16 and above, via the option in the Purchase Menu.

The Celestial Market goes hand in hand with Crew Retrieval to provide you with a path to obtain/complete the crew that matter to you. Find/keep an eye out for that one polestar you’re missing or sell unwanted constellations/polestars. All transactions use ISM as currency. 

When entering the market for the first time you will be presented with a brief tutorial. For additional information, and/or a refresher, please refer to the info text accessible at any time.

A brief introductory video, narrated by our very own Fury, is also available via this link: 

https://youtu.be/bCrIl5hD44w

If you do not wish to sell some of your Polestars or Constellations in the Celestial Market, you can now [b]dematerialize[/b] them. Constellations can be dematerialized for 300 ISM, Polestars for 800 ISM, and this from within their respective inventory.

[b]Important note[/b]: due to their nature all fulfilled transactions in the Celestial Market [b]are final[/b]. Player Support will not revert/cancel any fulfilled transaction.

We are looking forward to your feedback!


Thank you for playing,

The STAR TREK TIMELINES Team

notes.title: 8.1.1 is the new 8.1.0 - iOS 8.0.2 Upcoming Force Update
notes.notes:
Greetings, Captains,

When we released 8.1.0 on Facebook and Steam earlier this week, it introduced an issue where ship battles would end without showing the final screen.  This has now been fixed with the release of v8.1.1.

v8.1.1 (version 210336) is similar to v8.1.0 and is now live on Facebook and Steam. It will be rolled out to Windows, Google Play, and iOS next week, followed by a release on our other android platforms (Amazon, Huawei, and Samsung). 

This new update will introduce various changes, some [b]of these changes will only go live once all players are on v8.1.1.[/b] A forced update is currently scheduled for 07/19 after which v8.1.1 will be mandatory to continue playing.

What’s new in v8.1.1?

[b]Main interface[/b]
- the Limited Offers can now be found on the right side of the screen instead of the left 
-  the new Purchase Menu replaces the Time Portal button and gives access to 
   - the Time Portal
   - the Faction Trading Center
   - the Celestial Market [b](not live yet)[/b]

[b]Faction Trading Center[/b]
Enjoy a warpless faction shopping experience, all faction trading centers are now accessible with one click, without the need to travel.

[b]Expanded crew details in Crew inventory[/b]
Managing one’s roster is usually done from within Crew inventory, as such we’ve streamlined the experience. Full crew stats and crew retrieval access are now also available from within detailed crew stats.

[b]Celestial Market (not live yet)[/b]
The Celestial Market goes hand in hand with Crew Retrieval to provide you with a path to obtain/complete the crew that matter to you. Find/keep an eye out for that one polestar you’re missing or sell unwanted constellations/polestars. All transactions use ISM as currency. 

For an overview of Celestial Market please check this link: 

[b]Constellations/Polestars Inventory[/b]
Constellations and Polestars can be found in their respective tabs in your inventory, as opposed to regular game items. Selecting a Constellation/Polestar will show additional options:

- [b]Polestars[/b]
[i][b]View in Retrieval[/b][/i]: will allow you to access Crew Retrieval and see which crew are available by using that specific Polestar

- [b]Constellations/Polestars - Not live yet[/b]:
- [b][i]Sell Now[/b][/i]: this option will be displayed if there is at least one order available in the Celestial Market, and will allow you to quickly sell to fulfill that order
- [b][i]Sell[/i][/b] : this option will be displayed when there are no Orders for that constellation/polestar in the Celestial Market, and will allow you to create a listing to offer it for sale
- [b][i]Dematerialize[/b][/i] : allows you to get rid of a Constellation for 300 ISM, and of a Polestar for 800 ISM.

[b]Crew Retrieval Confirmation[/b]
Based on feedback we’ve iterated on the confirmation pop up when retrieving crew, making it clearer by bringing attention to the size of the pool you are retrieving from.

We hope that you’ll enjoy these updates and we are looking forward to your feedback!


[b]iOS 8.0.2[/b]
Regarding our current iOS version, v8.0.2, it was released for a minor backend change on June 23. A force update is scheduled for early next week at which point v8.0.2 will be required to continue playing

Thank you for playing,

The STAR TREK TIMELINES Team

What’s new in Version 8.1.1:
- Use ISM to exchange Polestars and Constellations with other players within the brand new Celestial Market!
- Dematerialize unwanted Polestars and Constellations for ISM
Both these features will be enabled once all players are on 8.1.1
- Easily browse and shop through each Faction Center without needing to travel 
- Enjoy a more streamlined interface with the new Purchase menu for an easy access to the Time Portal, Faction Trading Center, and the Celestial Market
- Fix for Ship Battle Reward Ui not displaying.

notes.title: Announcing our Players’ Choice Mega-Event: “Ends and Means”
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28588170/784e13728bfd5bcc3bc5691b00f358df370f18d9.png[/img]

Greetings, Captains!

Back in March we requested your input in choosing the theme of our Players’ Choice Mega-Event among three broad themes. “Harsh conditions” won, followed by “possession” while “sports” gathered the least votes.

Here’s an overview of our Players’ Choice mega-event [b]“Ends and Means”[/b]:

[i]Quark has a lead on a potential solution to the temporal anomaly crisis within the Dosi, a business-minded species with brutal negotiation tactics. Quark knows they’re difficult to deal with, but isn’t resolving the crisis worth any price? But do the Dosi actually have a meaningful solution, or are they forcing Starfleet officers to endure harsh conditions and brutal experiences for another reason?[/i]

As the recurrent mega-event character “Tribble Quark” will be available as a threshold reward in all four events part of the “Ends and Means” mega story arc. 

We hope you’ll enjoy this latest Quark variant, alongside crew with the “survivalist” trait it will also provide an event bonus for each event.

The schedule of events will be:

- “A Good Lead” - [b]Galaxy Event[/b] - 06/03
- “Playing Hardball” - [b]Skirmish Event[/b] - 06/10
- “The Spotlight's Glare” - [b]Faction/Galaxy Event[/b] - 06/17
- “Fool's Gold” - [b]Faction Event[/b] - 06/24

Throughout this mega-event you will encounter new variants of familiar crew such as Sisko, Jake, Bashir, O’Brien, Kira, and even a new Garak.

We’re looking forward to your participation!

Thank you for playing,

The STAR TREK TIMELINES Team

With our “Immortal Conception” Event - starting on [b]Thursday, February 25[/b] - we’re making some changes and some additions to the event ranked rewards. 

Starting with that event you will be able to gain Honor, ISM, [b]Rarity[/b], and [b]Skill[/b] Constellations by participating and ranking in events. We’ve also expanded the ranks at which Dilithium can be obtained.


Here is a breakdown of the changes/additions:

- removal of 3* crew as ranked reward
- removal of 1x Premium Reward as ranked rewards
- Dilithium: from rank 100000 and above (previously obtainable at rank 1000 and above)
- addition of Honor: from rank 15000 and above
- addition of ISM: from rank 5000 and above
- addition of Rarity Constellation: from rank 1000 and above
- addition of Skill Constellation: from rank 250 and above

You can see these changes in the Event Hub, we hope you’ll enjoy them, and are looking forward to your feedback.

Thank you for playing,

The STAR TREK TIMELINES Team

notes.title: Crew Retrieval is Live!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28588170/940d5f7232caf2a5e43b5327adb5afb42091e0fb.png[/img]

Greetings, Captains,

We’re happy to announce that our new [b]Crew Retrieval[/b] feature is now fully live! Make sure to [b]restart[/b] your game to see the changes.


[b]Crew Retrieval[/b] is now available for all players [b]level 16+[/b], and can be accessed within the Manifest menu on the main interface. This new feature allows you to retrieve crew using Polestars!


Accessing Crew Retrieval for the first time will initiate the [b]Crew Retrieval Tutorial[/b].
This tutorial, that cannot be skipped, will walk you through the various steps related to this new feature. At the end of the tutorial all players will get to retrieve Data Q.

[b]Crew Retrieval Welcome Gift![/b]
To celebrate the full release of our new feature we will have a [b]free Welcome Gift[/b] available to all players [b]level 10+[/b], it contains Credits, ISM, a Polestar and a Constellation. This gift will be available in the Time Portal [b]around noon ET (17:00 UTC)[/b].

We will also have a daily Welcome Pack, starting today around noon ET (17:00 UTC). This pack will appear and be claimable daily, until Thursday, February 25.


Don’t forget the Crew Retrieval-related Temporary Achievements to unlock even more goodies.


Now that Crew Retrieval is live, you will hear about more exciting things coming soon, including changes to Event Ranked Rewards, and Campaign Rewards. Stay tuned for more details on those in the future.


Thank you for your continued support!


The STAR TREK TIMELINES Team

notes.title: Announcing Phase 2 of our Crew Retrieval feature rollout!
notes.notes:
Greetings, Captains,

We’re happy to announce that [b]phase 2[/b] of the rollout of our new Crew Retrieval feature will be happening tonight with the daily reset! At approximately 12:00am ET (5:00 UTC), the following changes will go live: 

[b]Scanning update[/b], which includes:

- the Scanning Daily Mission goal will now require one scan instead of three
- each scan will still grant a salvage item, as before, but will also increase your chance to discover a Constellation
- once a Constellation is discovered the chance percentage gets reset
- you will get one free scan per game day
- additional scans will cost [b]ISM[/b]
- ISM cost increases with each additional scan but resets with a new game day (at 5:00 UTC)

[b]Important note[/b]: to allow everyone to enjoy a Constellation as soon as possible, we’ve made it so that the first scan after this scanning update is live is guaranteed to yield a Constellation!


[b]Inventory update[/b], which includes: 

- the inventory screen will now have three sections; one each for [b]Items[/b], [b]Constellations[/b], and [b]Polestars[/b].
- within the Constellations inventory, you will be able to open the Constellations you own (with ISM) to receive Polestars.

Please note that: [u]only the Items section of the Inventory is subject to the 1000 unique items cap.[/u]


[b]Crew Retrieval Temporary Achievements![/b]

How about some temporary achievements to get some Constellations, ISM, and Credits?

Start date: [b]Wednesday February 10, at daily reset (5:00 UTC - 12am ET)[/b]
End Date: [b]Thursday, February 25, at daily reset (5:00 UTC - 12am ET)[/b] 

These achievements will have to be completed, and rewards claimed, [b]before[/b] the daily reset on Thursday, February 25 (5:00 UTC - 12am ET)


Temporary Achievements Details: 

[b]Complete Scans[/b]
- Milestones: 1, 2, 3, 5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30, 35, 40 scans performed
- Reward per milestone achieved: 500,000 Credits for a total of 5,500,000 Credits if all 11 milestones are reached.

[b]Immortalize your Crew Members[/b]
- Milestones: 2 - immortalize one crew for each milestone
- Rewards: 
Milestone 1: 1x rarity Constellation 
Milestone 2 : 1x skill Constellation

[b]Retrieve Crew[/b] (use the Crew Retrieval feature)
- Milestones: 3 - retrieve one crew for each milestone
- Rewards:
Milestone 1: 1,000 ISM
Milestone 2: 1x skill Constellation
Milestone 3: 1x skill Constellation



Stay tuned for an announcement about the timing of Phase 3, the full release of our Crew Retrieval feature! We can’t wait for you to experience it first hand.

Thank you for your continued support!


The STAR TREK TIMELINES Team

notes.title: Client Release Notes 8.0.0
notes.notes:
Greetings, Captains,

Our latest client, v8.0.0 is now live on Facebook and Steam. It will be rolled out to Windows and Google Play in the coming days. The iOS release is scheduled for next week, followed by a release on our other android platforms (Amazon, Huawei, and Samsung).

A reminder: for our Android release the minimum operating system requirement was raised from 4.1 to 4.4. Devices on android 4.1 will no longer be able to run the game.

Now off to the juicy parts!

With this update we’ll be introducing a brand new feature to the game, [b]Crew Retrieval[/b]! 

This feature will provide you with the means to have more agency to [b]target the specific crew[/b] that you want, and add them to your roster, something that has been long requested.

This new game mechanic required a lot of careful considerations (such as a crew trait audit for instance, see our separate communication on that subject), it touches several existing game systems, and as a result will need to be released in multiple phases.

We understand that you want more details, this will be provided on [b]Wednesday, February 3[/b]. 

On that date you can expect a high level introduction to Crew Retrieval and related changes, as well as a detailed roll out plan explaining each release phase. This will be done via forum posts and in-game mails, but that’s not all! 
Our very own WRG Ben will showcase Crew Retrieval on the Timelines Talks stream on Wednesday, February 3 at 3:30 pm ET (20:30 UTC)! Don’t miss this opportunity to have a first look at this exciting new feature! 
www.youtube.com/TimelinesTalks

During the stream, Ben’s main focus will be to present Crew Retrieval, he won’t have the opportunity to answer questions.

We understand that you’ll have questions however and we’ll welcome them in a dedicated forum discussion that will be created on February 3!

[b]What can you expect once you upgrade to 8.0.0?[/b]

Some of the changes adjacent to the Crew Retrieval feature will be visible immediately upon updating:

- [b]Main Interface - Manifest Icon[/b]

Next to Daily Missions, the new Manifest icon replaces the Crew icon and will be the new home for accessing your Crew, Ships, Inventory, Cryostasis Vault, and later on, Crew Retrieval.

- [b]Crew Details[/b]

Knowing the final stats of a crew (FF/FE and 1/X FE level 100) plays an important role in making crew management decisions, but that critical information was not displayed in-game.

This will no longer be the case, we’re happy to announce that this quality of life improvement is part of our 8.0.0 update! 

The new Crew Details Pop-Up panel will be present throughout many areas of the game, giving you the ability to look at a crew’s description, traits, stats and ship abilities. 


We’ve been hard at work on this client for the past several months, and can’t wait to deliver the results to you all.

Thank you for your continued support!


The STAR TREK TIMELINES Team

notes.title: Server Release Notes 2021-01-12
notes.notes:
Greetings, Captains,

With this week’s server release we’re making two changes involving Credits:

- [b]Captain Level Up Rewards[/b]
We’re increasing the amount of Credits received as part of the Captain’s level up rewards. 
Increased Level 2 reward from 10,000 to 25,000
Increased Level 3 reward from 10,000 to 50,000
Increased Level 4 reward from 10,000 to 75,000
Updated all other Captain Level Credit rewards to 100,000

- [b]Purchasing Credits with Dilithium[/b]

Purchasing Credits with Dilithium can be done multiple times during a game day, the Dilithium cost increasing with each purchase. The cost increase resets each day with the daily reset at 5:00 UTC (currently 12:00 am ET).

The daily Credits purchase cost schedule has been modified and the amount of Credits that can be purchased with Dilithium has been increased from 15,000 to 50,000 per purchase.

New purchase schedule (50,000 Credits per purchase)
1-2: 50 Dilithium
3-6: 100 Dilithium
7-8: 150 Dilithium
9+: 200 Dilithium 

Previous to this change the schedule (15,000 Credits per purchase) was:

1: 10 Dilithium
2-4: 20 Dilithium
5-7: 40 Dilithium
8-10: 80 Dilithium
11+: 150 Dilithium


[b]Premium Rewards Packs Behold Change[/b]
Each 4* and 5* crew pulled from a 1-pack Premium Rewards or a 10-pack Premium Rewards will now be presented as a behold offering a choice between three crew of the same rarity.
Other packs, such as Basic Rewards, themed packs, or event packs, will remain unchanged.

[b]Our 5th anniversary avatar is now live[/b]
Grudge is now live. This avatar will be available for all Captains having been with us from the very beginning. Newer Captains will have to wait until their game account turns five.

[b]Adira Tal Update[/b]: we’re in the process of finishing the crew. We’ll let you know next week when it has been finalized and awarded to the eligible ranked players from the “A Stitch Saves Nine” event.

Thank you for playing,

The STAR TREK TIMELINES Team

Greetings, Captains!

It is time to announce our December Mega-Event: The Cosmic Divide.

[i]Time travel comes with many consequences. The chaos of the temporal anomaly crisis has made this all too clear, but also masked certain physical consequences from coming to light--until now. Work with members of Discovery’s crew to learn the truth, save countless lives, and prevent the Orion Syndicate and an empress of the Mirror Universe from taking advantage.?[/i]

This mega-event is themed around [i]Star Trek:Discovery[/i] and the Mirror Universe, as such you can expect to encounter Discovery and Mirror Universe crew, old and new.

The Cosmic Divide mega-event will span over four weeks, for each event the recurrent bonus trait will be “Mirror Universe”. The recurrent threshold reward will be a brand new variant of Michael Burnham: [b]Courier Burnham[/b], as seen in the beginning of [i]Star Trek:Discovery[/i] Season 3!

The schedule of events will be as follow:

[b]Hybrid Galaxy/Faction Event[/b] -  “Tick Tock” - December 10 - (bonus accolades)

notes.title: Server Release Notes September 28
notes.notes:
Greetings, Captains!

With today’s server release we’re making a small change to the game that will improve how battle arena fights are being handled, and this specifically for daily missions (and temporary achievements).

From this point forward we will look at when a battle starts instead of when it completes. 

This means that anything that could prevent a battle arena ship battle from completing properly will no longer negatively impact the relevant daily mission (likewise for temporary achievements).


The description of the daily mission will also be modified accordingly, but at a later date.

We will of course continue to look into what causes crashes in battle arena.


Thank you for playing,

The STAR TREK TIMELINES Team

notes.title: Announcing our August Mega-Event: The Capitoline Wolf
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28588170/f5c48f7097adbff5c5f75a80cda4b443c96105b0.png[/img]

Greetings, Captains!

A few months ago you chose the theme of the Players’ Choice Mega-Event that took place in June. Voyager won, but Enterprise came in second by a narrow margin. For this reason we’ve decided to have an Enterprise themed Mega-Event for August!

[i]A startling discovery is made in the Neutral Zone: evidence of an ancient Romulan-Human civilization, originating on Earth! Explore this rapidly unfolding alternate history in which much of humanity’s accomplishments have been erased, but also much of their mistakes, thanks to Romulan influence. But when the Tal Shiar move to take advantage of this past to secure their future, will you restore the original history of Earth, with all its error and bloodshed? Or will you give the Romulans a permanent place in the story of humanity?[/i]

[b]The Capitoline Wolf[/b] Mega-Event will consist of four weekly events during which you will encounter various crew seen on [i]Star Trek:Enterprise[/i], characters such as Erika Hernandez, Alicia Travers, Jhamel, and even Phlox in an EV Suit.

For this arc the recurring threshold reward will be the mysterious (??) Humanoid Figure ..

As for event bonus, crew from [i]Star Trek:Enterprise[/i] (as listed below) will provide some for all four events!

The schedule of events will be: 

- August 13: Skirmish Event - Cultural Property
- August 20: Faction Event - Plateau of Tomorrow
- August 27: Galaxy Event - Whistles and Canaries
- September 3 : Hybrid Event Galaxy/Skirmish - Restoration

We hope that you’ll enjoy The Capitoline Wolf Mega-Event, and we are looking forward to your participation.


Thank you for playing!

The STAR TREK TIMELINES Team

notes.title: v7.5.2 Release Notes
notes.notes:
Greetings, Captains!

Our latest client, v7.5.2, is now live on Facebook, Facebook Gameroom, and Steam. It will be rolled out to all remaining platforms in the coming days.

With this update to the game we’re introducing the following additions and changes, some of which will only be available after [b]a force upgrade[/b], and this to ensure all players are on 7.5.2.

[b]Active Buffs[/b]
Starbase Rooms and Collections are a good way to gain helpful gameplay buffs.
Accessible via your Captain’s profile, the Active Buffs section allows you to have a global overview of all your current buffs, but also to filter them between fleet buffs, and collections buffs. This should make it easier to decide what type of buff you want to prioritize.

[b]The following changes will only be available once every player is on 7.5.2, after a force upgrade.[/b]

[b]Ship Management[/b] (NOT LIVE YET)
This section of the game badly needed a revamp and it has now been done!
Similar to crew management, ships will now be displayed in a grid, and allow for various filtering options.

[b]Ship Battles[/b] (including skirmishes - NOT LIVE YET)
To allow for more flexibility in gameplay, we’re adding 2 togglable options to ship battles:
- Speed Up: to increase the velocity of the battle 
- Auto Mode: as the name implies, when Auto is ON, the ship battle will play out automatically, without your input. Please note that with Auto Mode ON, abilities will be triggered as they become available. 

Both Auto Mode and Speed Up can be toggled during a ship battle, to allow you more control on your crew/ship abilities.

Speed Up and Auto Mode will reset to their default (1x - OFF) once a ship battle ends.

We’re also adding an option to [b]skip[/b] the intro and outro animation for ship battles.

Please note that these features are not live yet, but will be enabled at a future date.


[b]Bug fixes[/b]
- fixed an issue where trying to link a game account to a Facebook profile would result in the game freezing
- fixed an issue where the game would crash when loading or during a ship battle (Facebook client)
- fixed an issue where skill icons would sometimes not be visible during an away-mission (Facebook client)



Thank you for playing!

The STAR TREK TIMELINES Team

notes.title: An update about 7.5.0 + In This Together
notes.notes:
Greetings, Captains!

We have another care package for you today, you have one week to claim it in the Time Portal.

Last week we released our new client, v7.5.0, on Steam and Facebook, but we had to revert back to 7.4.2 due to an issue discovered shortly after the update went live.

The issue has now been fixed, and we will proceed in updating all platforms in the coming days, but under a new client number, v7.5.2.

We apologize for any inconvenience this might have caused, and are sending you 350 Honor to thank you for your continued support.

Thank you for being part of our community!

PlayApartTogether and stay safe, 


The STAR TREK TIMELINES Team

notes.title: All Hands to Battle Stations!
notes.notes:
Attention all Captains, our scans have revealed a critical mass of  temporal anomalies. Starfleet needs your help to prevent a potentially universe-collapsing catastrophe! 

Next week, you can both save the universe and lend the STAR TREK TIMELINES development team a hand by participating in an exciting new take on events.

We’re talking about a [b]mini event[/b] that will take place from [b]Monday, March 2[/b] at 12:31pm ET (17:31 UTC) until [b]Wednesday March 4[/b] at 11:59am ET (16:59 UTC) - [u]there will be no overlap with the regular event[/u].

Why a mini event?

We have multiple goals in mind:
- propose a potentially reoccurring mid-week activity that is familiar yet has a few twists
- provide a new way to get specific rewards
- test out balance changes without impacting our regular events
- gather specific feedback

There will be a 30 minutes announcement phase for this mini-event, and [b]no featured crew[/b] - the event has been designed to allow for spontaneous participation without the need for preparation.

As for campaigns your feedback will be very much appreciated, and we are looking forward to your participation in next week's mini event!


Thank you for playing,

The STAR TREK TIMELINES Team

For this campaign the featured crew will be: [b]Rakal Troi 4 *[/b] for the standard reward track, and [b]Age of Sail Data 5*[/b] for the premium track.

[u]Dev notes[/u]:

It’s been a while since we’ve seen Data or Troi appear in Star Trek, and we wanted to welcome them back with our next campaign. 

[b]Rakal Troi[/b] comes with Command, Security, and Medicine skills coupled with a variety of traits that are difficult to find on Troi variants. Already having Empath and Betazoid, this version of Troi adds on more unusual traits such as Tal Shiar, Undercover Operative, and Romulan. 

[b]Age of Sail Data[/b] brings skills of Command, Engineering, as well as Diplomacy -- and portrays one of Data’s attempts at being funny. He possesses a variety of traits such as Costumed and Explorer, alongside some Data evergreens like Android and Musician, making this a good choice to help occupy some tough Voyage seats.

Long Time, No See will start on [b]Thursday, February 20 at 12am ET (05:00 UTC)[/b] and end on [b]Thursday, March 19 at 12:59am ET (Thursday, March 19 at 04:59 UTC)[/b]!

notes.title: STAR TREK TIMELINES Turns Four!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28588170/8e98e9b84391add50a34026649a2ec6e495b9b12.png[/img]

Happy fourth anniversary, Captains!

Four years is not a small feat, and what an interesting ride it has been so far. 
We’re glad that you’re part of this adventure with us, and we’re looking forward to what the future will bring.

Star Trek is such a great universe to be a part of. We could not be happier to see it evolve and expand - as such it is our great pleasure to announce that [i][b]Star Trek: Picard[/b][/i] will be part of STAR TREK TIMELINES! Just like for [i]Star Trek: Discovery[/i] you can expect to encounter characters from this exciting new show in the game, in the following weeks.

Now onto our anniversary celebrations:

- Please welcome Dr. ‘Bones’ McCoy in your crew. [b]Later today[/b] all players will be able to claim this new 5* crew in the Time Portal. This also doubles up as a celebration for what would have been DeForest Kelley 100th’s birthday this year. And for the occasion we’ve a specific audio clip for this character!

- We’re also providing you with a way to receive three additional copies of this new crew by way of three temporary achievements that will be added to the game. [u]Those temporary achievements will be available until Tuesday, February 11[/u]. [b]If you were already logged in today prior to the achievements going live you will need to wait until the next reset to see them, fear not you will have plenty of time to complete these achievements.[/b]  

The temporary achievements are:
- complete 15 Dilemmas
- complete 100 Gauntlets
- complete 280 Space Battles

Dr. ‘ Bones’ McCoy
FE/FF level 100 MED 1641 (98-360)
FE 1/5 level 100 MED 1251 (98-360)
Traits: Federation, Starfleet, Human, Physician, Resourceful, Exobiology

- Picard’s [b]Livingstone[/b] is our fourth anniversary avatar! He is available today for the Captains who were with us from the very beginning. For everyone else, that special avatar will be available once your game account turns four.

- Special Honor offers will be available every day until Tuesday, January 21, in the Time Portal. So be sure to check them out every day.

- Last but not least, all limited-time offers will include 1x 5* citation on top of their regular content, and this until Thursday, January 30. Don’t miss out.

Thank you for taking part in this extraordinary journey with us. Engage!

The STAR TREK TIMELINES Team

notes.title: Inventory cap clarification and correction
notes.notes:
Greetings, Captains!

It has come to our attention that there is a misunderstanding about our latest client v7.4.0 and the inventory cap, as well as an error in our client release notes.

Please allow us to clarify: 

- the inventory being capped at 1,000 unique items, and the automatic deletion of items over that cap, [b] are not features that have been implemented with our v7.4.0 update[/b]. 

This system has been in place since the release of the game but was not being surfaced properly to players. This is what we are trying to address with this update, while also providing some solutions for inventory management.

Regarding the creation of a replicator ration via the inventory, we are aware that there is an issue with the credit cost. This will be addressed at a future date.

- our release notes erroneously stipulated that a notification would be shown when the inventory cap is reached; this is incorrect. The notification will appear when your inventory reaches 975 unique items to allow for plenty of time to sort through your inventory at your leisure.

We hope this provides clarification on the matter, and we apologize for any confusion our earlier release notes might have caused.

Thank you for playing,

The STAR TREK TIMELINES Team

notes.title: v7.4.0 Release Notes - Edited 01/08
notes.notes:
Greetings, Captains!

Our latest client, v7.4.0, is now live on Facebook, Facebook Gameroom, and Steam. It will be rolled out to all remaining platforms in the coming days. Please update as soon as it becomes available to you.

[b]Once all players are on 7.4.0 (this will require a force upgrade):[/b] Battle Arena and Cadet Challenges will no longer require any cooldowns! 

[b]Inventory[/b]
The long awaited changes to the inventory are finally here. The cap is still in place but we’ve made the following improvements:

[b]- a notification will now be shown once the inventory reaches 975 unique items to give advance warning that you are nearing the cap[/b] - edit 01/08
- items that are in overflow and selected to be automatically deleted will be highlighted in red
- any item can now be used towards creating the replicator ration of your choice (these rations will not count towards the daily limit)
- any item can now simply be discarded

All the above is explained in the newly added inventory info text.
[b]Fleet chat:[/b] fixed an issue where a player kicked from a fleet could access fleet/Squadron chat while their game session was still active.

We hope these changes will provide for a better gameplay experience, and we are looking forward to your feedback.


Thank you for playing!

The STAR TREK TIMELINES Team

Our upcoming campaign covers the end of 2019, the beginning of 2020, and more importantly our upcoming 4th anniversary!

That’s a lot to celebrate and we found just the right crew for it: [b]Celebratory Ash Tyler 4 *[/b] for the standard reward track, and [b]Queen Po 5*[/b] for the premium track.

Both will make a nice addition to your crew to warp into 2020! 

Celebratory Ash Tyler can help fill some Diplomacy, Command, and Security spots on your voyages or shuttles. His variety of traits are also useful to help earn bonus Victory Points, or Antimatter.

With her Engineering, Diplomacy, and Command trio of skills Queen Po is not just about ice cream, her jury rigging abilities are also to be reckoned with. On top of that she features in both the [b]Spit and Bailing Wire[/b] and [b]The Daystrom Award[/b] collections, and has additional useful but difficult to find traits, like Royalty and Spiritual.

Don’t miss out on these crew and the other valuable rewards This campaign will start on [b]Thursday, December 26 at 12am ET (05:00 UTC)[/b] and end on [b]Wednesday, January 22 at 11:59pm ET (Thursday, January 23 at 04:59 UTC)[/b]!


Live long and prosper!

The STAR TREK TIMELINES Team

notes.title: 12 Days of Offers and a sale!
notes.notes:
Greetings, Captains!

2019 is slowly coming to an end and it has been quite the year. We are looking forward to boldly go into 2020 with you, our players.

What better way to celebrate than by giving everyone [b]5 free crew slots[/b]!  (This brings the base crew slots to 110) 

[b]12 days of special offers and a sale![/b]

Starting now and until Tuesday, December 31, around 11am ET (16:00 UTC), enjoy:

[b]Daily limited-time offers![/b]
Log in every day to discover a new limited-time offer. Each offer will go live around noon ET (17:00 UTC) and will only be available for [b]22 hours[/b] so make sure to take advantage of it before it goes away.
Please note that the last offer will go live on Monday, December 30.


[b]A Crew Slots and Dabo Wheel Sale![/b] 
All [b]crew slots tiers[/b] and all [b]Dabo Wheel spins[/b] are [b]50%[/b] off! 
We’ve also added [b]5 more tiers of purchasable crew slots[/b] for a total of 88 purchasable tiers. 

[b]What’s on the horizon for 2020?[/b]
The very first thing on our list is some quality of life improvements, mainly the long awaited inventory improvements that will prevent disappearing items. Look for this and more in our next update. As always your feedback is, and always will be, very much appreciated.

Live long and prosper!

notes.title: November Campaign Announcement!
notes.notes:
Greetings, Captains!

Our current Campaign will end on [b]Thursday, October 31 at 12:59am ET (04:59 UTC)[/b]! You still have one week to participate and win some awesome rewards.

Did you know that Whoopi Goldberg, who played Guinan, has a birthday on November 13? This felt like a good reason to feature not one but two Guinan in our campaign!
 
[b]Nexus Guinan 4*[/b] for the Standard Rewards track and [b]Gloria 5*[/b] for the Premium Rewards track (at tiers 20, 40, 60 and 80). 

Crew highlights: 

- Nexus Guinan has the rare combination of the MED/DIP/SCI skills, and is one of the highest MED cores with 4 stars.
- Gloria's the only crew with the DIP/CMD/MED order of skills, and her proficiencies help put her above many other crew in the gauntlet. 


In addition to their stats, both have some rare traits, such as Counselor and Empath among others. These two Guinan's could help you track down the other variants of her found in Gauntlet or Voyages.

This campaign will start on [b]Thursday, October 31 at 1am ET (05:00 UTC)[/b] and end on [b]Thursday, November 28 at 12:59am ET (04:59 UTC)[/b]!

Please note that the Premium Reward Track for a specific Campaign can be purchased at any time during that Campaign, up until the very end – and even once the Campaign has ended! If you decide to unlock the Premium Reward Track after already unlocking regular Tiers of rewards, you will retroactively receive all of the Premium Rewards for those Tiers. 


Cheers!

The STAR TREK TIMELINES Team

notes.title: Announcing our October Mega-Event: Mudd Amuck!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28588170/48fb8893616129fdf66f5008ecd1614cf924c816.png[/img]
As is fitting for Halloween our October Mega-Event will task our captains to keep up, and more importantly catch up, with the infamous trickster that everyone loves to hate: Harry Mudd. This under the watchful eye of Tenavik, which will be the recurrent crew obtainable as threshold reward in each of these four events.

[b]Recover the stolen time crystals[/b]

Time crystals in the hands of Mudd are a recipe for havoc and disaster you will have to stop at nothing to get them back.
During these events, you will encounter and receive the assistance of new variants of Pike, Owosekun, Po, Burnham, and Saru. It will also be the opportunity for a first contact with Vina and the mysterious Ba’ul.


The schedule of events will be as follows:
[list]
[*] Faction Event "[b]Crime of Last Century[/b]" -  10/03
[*] Hybrid Faction/Galaxy Event "[b]One Step Behind[/b]" - 10/10
[*] Skirmish Event "[b]When Words Fail[/b]" - 10/17
[*] Faction Event "[b]Everywhere At Once[/b]" - 10/24
[/list]

Discovery crew will provide event bonuses throughout the Mega-Event.


Trick or .. more tricks!  Are you ready for it?

The STAR TREK TIMELINES Team

notes.title: October Campaign Announcement
notes.notes:
Greetings, Captains!

Our current Campaign will end on [b]Thursday, October 3 at 12:59am ET (04:59 UTC)[/b]! You still have one week to participate and win some awesome rewards.

October is all about Fall and of course Halloween! With that in mind our October Campaign will appropriately feature spooky crew: [b]M-113 Creature 4*[/b] for the Standard Rewards track and [b]Protomorphosis Barclay 5*[/b] for the Premium Rewards track (at tiers 20, 40, 60 and 80). 

Crew highlights: 
- The M-113 creature is the only super rare crew with the specific DIP/SEC/SCI skill combo, and brings a variety of traits alongside some [i]Star Trek: The Original Series[/i] nostalgia.
- Protomorphosis Barclay has a rare skill combo with SCI/ENG/SEC, coupled with a high science core.

This campaign will start on [b]Thursday, October 3 at 1am ET (05:00 UTC)[/b] and end on [b]Thursday, October 31 at 12:59am ET (04:59 UTC)[/b]!

Please note that the Premium Reward Track for a specific Campaign can be purchased at any time during that Campaign, up until the very end – and even once the Campaign has ended! If you decide to unlock the Premium Reward Track after already unlocking regular Tiers of rewards, you will retroactively receive all of the Premium Rewards for those Tiers. 


Cheers!

The STAR TREK TIMELINES Team

notes.title: Flashback Event 09/05
notes.notes:
Greetings, Captains!

On Thursday, September 5, we will be changing things up a bit with the introduction of a [b]flashback[/b] event, which is a second-run of an older event – in this case, Temporal Misalignment.

Flashback events differ from reruns in that there will be no new crew.

The featured event crew and rewards structure will be exactly the same as in the first instance of this event, except for the ranked 5* crew reward, which in this case will be Endgame Janeway (name subject to change).

Why are we doing a flashback? Because running an older event again with minimal changes gives our team more bandwidth to fix bugs, make long-awaited quality-of-life improvements, and build new features. 


Thank you for playing!

LLAP,

The STAR TREK TIMELINES team

This first Campaign will have a full length of [b]28[/b] days starting on [b]Thursday, April 18 at 1am ET (5:00 UTC)[/b] and ending on [b]Wednesday, May 16 at 12:59am ET (4:59 UTC)[/b].
