notes.title: STAR TREK TIMELINES Steam Beta FAQ
notes.notes:
Greetings, Captains!
 
Congratulations on being selected for the STAR TREK TIMELINES Steam Beta! To help prepare you for the Beta, we’ve compiled answers to some frequently asked questions about Steam further below. 
 
In the coming weeks, we will be distributing a survey to all Beta participants asking for your feedback. Please keep an eye out for that survey, as it is going to be the best way to provide the Disruptor Beam team with your input. In the meantime, we encourage all Beta participants to discuss your experience on the Steam Forums or on our official [url=https://forums.disruptorbeam.com/stt]Star Trek Timelines forums[/url].  If you encounter a technical issue, please always remember that the best way to get that addressed is to file a ticket with our [url=https://startrektimelines.zendesk.com/hc/en-us]Player Support team[/url]. 
 
No matter where you choose to discuss the Beta, we ask that you follow our [url=https://www.disruptorbeam.com/blog/2017/5/1/disruptor-beam-community-participation-guidelines]Community Participation Guidelines[/url] as well as the [url=https://support.steampowered.com/kb_article.php?ref=4045-USHJ-3810]Steam Discussions Rules and Guidelines[/url].
 
[b][u]Star Trek Timelines Steam Beta FAQ[/u][/b]
 
[b]Is this beta covered by a NDA (non disclosure agreement)?[/b]
This beta is not covered by an NDA. You are free to discuss your experience in the Steam Beta with your friends and others within the community. 

[b]Can I play on other systems like Mac or Linux?[/b]
STAR TREK TIMELINES for Steam is only available on Windows at this time.  
 
[b]Can I use my current account for the Beta or do I have to play with a new account?[/b]
You can use your current account or start a new one. If you plan to play regularly on Steam during and after this Beta period, we recommend that you use your current account.
 
[b]How do I sync my current Star Trek Timelines account with Steam?[/b]
 
[b][i]• If you started your Star Trek Timelines account on the web, via Facebook:[/i][/b]
Start STAR TREK TIMELINES on Steam, and complete the tutorial.
Once you reach level 4, go to the Menu located in the top right corner of the main screen, then choose Settings. 

Select "Create an Account" and in the next screen locate then select "Already have an Account?" and choose "Login to Account".

In the next screen, select "Login to Facebook" and follow the prompts that will be presented to you.
 
[b][i]• If you started your Star Trek Timelines account on a mobile device:[/i][/b]
[u]On your mobile device, make sure that your account is properly registered with either an email address and a password, or via Facebook.[/u]

To verify that your account is registered go to Menu ->Settings.
If you are registered with Facebook, you should see: "Logged in as [name of your FB profile]"
If you are registered with an email address and a password, you should see the email address associated with your account.
 
Once you have verified if and how your account is registered, start the game on Steam. Complete the tutorial, and once you reach level 4, go to the Menu located in the top right corner of the main screen, then choose Settings. 
Select "Create an Account" and in the next screen locate then select "Already have an Account?" and choose "Login to Account".

In the next screen:
- enter your email address and password for your current STT account and click on "Login"
Or
- select "Login to Facebook"
Follow the prompts that will be presented to you.
 
[b]I have forgotten the password for my Star Trek Timelines account, what should I do?[/b]
If your Star Trek Timelines account is registered with an email address, and you have forgotten your password, you will need to initiate a password reset.
 
This is done on our website, by going to http://games.disruptorbeam.com/login, and clicking on "Forgot Password?" found in the top bar of the page. When prompted, fill in your email address, and follow the instructions given.

[b]How to do I redeem my Star Trek Timelines key?[/b]
To use the key that you have received in our email, go to Steam.

In Steam, at the bottom left of the interface locate [b]+ ADD A GAME[/b], select “Activate a Product on Steam”, follow the prompts and add your key when requested. 

Once this is done, you will find Star Trek Timelines in your library, and will have the option to install.
 
[b]May I play multiple accounts?[/b]
If you have more than one registered Star Trek Timelines account, you will be able to access them on Steam the same way as on any other platforms, by using the "Switch Account" feature found in Account Management.
 
[b]Will I be able to make purchases, and if necessary, ask for a refund?[/b]
You will be able to make purchases while playing the Steam Beta, [b]but please note that refunds are currently not available for the Steam platform[/b]. While refunds are only granted in rare, and specific occasions, should you prefer to have that option available, we recommend making your purchases via another platform for the time being.
 
[b]Will there be Ads in the Steam version?[/b]
Ads are a feature only available on the mobile versions of the game.
 
[b]How and where can I provide feedback?[/b]
If you are loving your experience with Star Trek Timelines on Steam, we encourage you to post on the Steam Forums. We will also be sending a survey out mid-month to get your feedback. If you are experiencing an issue please following the instructions in the answer to the next question.
 
[b]What do I do if I encounter an issue with the game?[/b]
For any issue with your account please contact our Support Team via:

• from within the game itself. Go into the Menu located in the top right corner of the main screen, and then choose "Contact Support".
• via sttsupport.disruptorbeam.com
• by email via sttsupport[at]disruptorbeam[dot]com

[b]Is there a game guide available?[/b]
There is! You can find it here: https://www.disruptorbeam.com/games/star-trek-timelines/game-guide
 
We hope you enjoy your time in the Star Trek Timelines Steam Beta, and we look forward to hearing your feedback! 
 
LLAP
-The Star Trek Timelines Team
